The '''Celen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]].
